objective: Convert @apply directives to CSS custom properties
action: Replace @apply with direct CSS using var(--sys-type-*) tokens

mappings.h1: font-family: 'Libre Bodoni', serif; font-size: var(--sys-type-display-large-size); line-height: var(--sys-type-display-large-line-height); font-weight: var(--sys-type-weight-bold); letter-spacing: var(--sys-type-display-large-tracking);
